desc: Ideation complete: choose DSU over present values and auxiliary multiple nodes.
Implement DSU with path compression and union by size for n + threshold + 1 nodes.
In countComponents, union each original node whose value x <= threshold with auxiliary nodes n + x, n + 2x, ..., n + threshold.
Count unique DSU roots among all original nodes to get the number of connected components.
Verify sample tests and edge cases such as threshold = 1, all values > threshold, and presence of 1.
Confirm performance and memory are acceptable for n <= 1e5 and threshold <= 2e5.
